notes.title: Open Beta 58 Patch Notes | Beats Purr Minute :3
notes.notes:
https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/09/ForumPost-PatchNotes-OB58-690x275-JT.jpg
Beats Purr Minute :3
Open Beta 58 Patch Notes | September 7th
Beta Expectations

General

 	The Preparatory phase of each match will be in third person

 	Before a match you will notice something different! For the first spawn room phase of a game you will now be able to control and navigate your character in third person!


 	In the Competitive Queue player will have an additional 15 seconds to pick a character.
 	Added a new flow for opening Radiant Chests in place of the Enchant Key button when selecting Open Chest.
 	Muting a player will now also mute their VGS.
 	Damage and Healing Indicator Improvements

 	Corner damage VFX will now better correspond to where the player is being hit from.
 	Added incoming damage indicators around the crosshair.
 	Added incoming healing feedback with 2 possible locations:

 	Defaults to the left of the crosshair, can be set to above the player health bar.


 	Incoming heal numbers will now change color to indicate that the healing was reduced by healing reduction.
 	Friendly health bars will appear yellow-green when that player is under the effect of healing reduction.
 	"This patch we’ve put a big focus on improving feedback for both incoming damage and incoming heals. Now players should have the tools they need to better react to the world around them."


 	Aim Acceleration has been renamed to Turn Acceleration.

 	"We found that because of the use of the word “aim” some players were initially confused and thought that this setting somehow controlled Aim Assist. We have renamed it to Turn Acceleration which should be much more clear."



GRAPHICAL ENGINE UPDATES

 	DirectX 11 Beta

 	DirectX 11 is coming to Paladins. Using DirectX 11 will improve both CPU and GPU performance on devices that support DirectX 11 (both integrated and dedicated cards). Additionally, this unifies our rendering codebase between PC and Consoles, allowing any future performance improvements to benefit all our clients.
 	To participate in the DirectX 11 Beta go to Settings -> Video Options -> Check “Use D3D11 (BETA)” and restart your game.

 	NOTE: For PTS you will need to modify the “Optional Game Command Line Parameters” in the Launcher to: -dx11


 	While performance will generally be improved, memory usage may be higher. We will continue to optimize memory before our final release.
 	If you encounter a graphical issue or client instability, please report any issue you encounter. If you need to switch back simply uncheck “Use D3D11 (BETA)”.


 	Resolution Scaling

 	Players will now have the option to adjust their Resolution Scaling.
 	At values below 100%, the in-game resolution will decrease providing improved performance while the UI will stack at a higher display resolution for legibility.
 	At values above 100%, you can use additional GPU power to render the in-game resolution higher than your display resolution. This provides improved anti-aliasing (supersampling) which looks especially good in motion and provides more fine-grained detail.


 	64-Bit Client

 	We’re beginning tests of our new 64-bit client. We will roll this out to more and more players in the future and will provide specific improvements to the 64-bit client.
 	To use the 64-Bit client players will need to modify their “Optional Game Command Line Parameters” in the Launcher. To do this, hit the Cog Wheel on your launcher and type “-Use64” in the “Optional Game Command Line Parameters” and hit “Apply”.



GENERAL BUG FIXES

 	Fixed Quest page to display more Quests.
 	Fixed an issue with Backspace not functioning in some situations.
 	Fixed an issue with Strix Resourceful not applying to Flare properly.
 	Fixed an issue with Strix weapon swapping and Bushwack.
 	Fixed an issue with Strix Chronos not interacting with Flare.
 	Fixed an issue with Strix Guerilla Tactics not functioning properly.
 	Fixed an issue with Strix Stealth resource UI not appearing properly.
 	Fixed an issue with Skye Surprise Attack description.
 	Fixed an issue with Mal’Damba not healing in some situations.


VIP

"With this patch we are introducing the brand new VIP system! Players will earn points to unlock VIP exclusive content by playing games, completing daily quests, and selecting winners for Paladins esports matches. Players wanting to access this content faster can purchase VIP Membership or the VIP pack. Over the course of future patches we’ll be adding more and more content to the VIP store."

VIP Content
Every Patch we will release new exclusive content for the VIP store and/or rotate in previously available non-VIP content that will be available at a discount using VIP points.

 	Exclusive Content

 	Raeve Maeve
 	FN-01 Erebos Fernando
 	Goddess Lian
 	Pretty Hair Announcer Pack
 	Raynday Announcer Pack


 	Current Rotation

 	Steam Demon Androxus



VIP Points
Every game of Paladins you play will now earn you VIP Points.

 	50 Points per win.
 	25 Points per loss.

Stay in touch with our Esports scene (coming later this fall) and correctly guess the winners of our upcoming matches for additional VIP Points.

 	50 Points per correct guess.

Complete your weekly quests for even more VIP Points.

 	100 Points per weekly quest completed.

VIP Membership
Players who purchase the VIP membership bundle will gain membership status which gives bonuses to VIP point gain for a period of time. We also have plans for other cosmetic benefits for VIP members. VIP members also get:

 	+100 Points per win (in addition to normal 50 points).
 	+35 Points per loss (in addition to normal 25 points).
 	+100 Points per correct esports pick (in addition to normal 50 points).
 	+400 points per weekly quest (in addition to normal 100 points).

Pricing
VIP Pack ($14.99)

 	Conqueror Zhin Collection
 	70 Day VIP Membership (5x 2-week memberships)
 	25 Radiant Chests
 	25 VIP Team Boosters
 	100,000 VIP Points

14 Day VIP Membership (200 Crystals)

 	5 Radiant Chests (250 Crystal value!)
 	20,000 VIP Points
 	5 VIP Match Boosters

VIP Points (70 Crystals)

 	10,000 VIP Points
 	Only Purchasable if VIP


Customizations

Champions

 	Barik

 	General

 	New visual update to the Champion’s base model.
 	"Barik is getting a serious visual update this patch, addressing some art consistency and technical concerns. Our favorite little Master Mechanic got a new look that better reflects his personality and character in a way that ties him in better to our Paladins’ art style and fantasy theming. His trusty Blunderbuss and turrets are also getting a strong visual upgrade with model, animation, vfx, and audio improvements to reflect that wonderful Dwarven engineering. We are also giving Barik’s ultimate turret a unique model that reflects its importance and functionality."


 	Hi-Tek (old default skin)

 	Champion Skin + Weapon
 	Available for 1 Gold for a limited time






 	Cassie

 	Copacabana (Epic)

 	Champion skin + Voice Pack






 	Drogoz

 	Weapon: Samba Rocket Launcher




 	Fernando

 	FN-01 Erebos (Epic)

 	Champion skin + Weapon + Voice Pack + Spray






 	Jenos

 	Eclipse (Rare)

 	Champion skin
 	Weapon






 	Lex

 	Sarrada (Epic)

 	Champion skin + Voice Pack






 	Lian

 	Goddess (Epic)

 	Champion Skin + Weapon + Voice Pack + Spray






 	Kinessa

 	Weapon: Samba Sniper Rifle




 	Maeve

 	Raeve (Legendary)

 	Champion Skin + Weapon + Voice Pack + Spray






 	Ruckus

 	Ruckus B.E.T.A

 	Champion Skin is now 200 Crystals
 	Weapon is now 125 Crystals






 	Skye

 	Weapon: Samba Wristbow




 	Tyra

 	Weapon: Samba Auto Rifle




 	Zhin

 	Conqueror

 	Champion Skin + Weapon + Voice Pack





Announcer Packs

 	Nick “Prettyhair” Koegh (VIP store only)
 	Evan “Raynday” Raynr (VIP store only)

Chests

 	Samba Chest

 	Get a free Samba Chest when winning 5 Onslaught matches



Quests

 	Beach Bash

 	Quest: Win 5 Onslaught Games
 	Reward: 1 Samba Chest roll




Maps

 	Test Queue rotation

 	Siege: Eastwatch




 	Bug fixes:

 	Brightmarsh

 	Added explosion cart particles
 	Raised cart destination vfx








Champions

 	General

 	Bulldozer

 	Cost reduced from 300 to 200.
 	"Because deployables generally have fairly low health, Bulldozer is actually very effective at what it does. However, 300 credits was still too high a price for the utility when compared to other Damage cards. With this change hopefully we’ll see Bulldozer picked up when a player cares about being able to quickly deal with pesky deployables."





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/08/ChampionPortrait_Jenos_50.jpg

 	Jenos

 	Celestial Touch

 	Healing reduced from 15% of maximum health to 10% of maximum health.
 	"Jenos has proven to be a very strong healer with his potential for very high throughput when picking cards to buff his team more often, for longer. However, with Celestial Touch Jenos had strong throughput and strong burst, which is too powerful of a combination."





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/ChampionPortrait_Lian_50.png

 	Lian

 	Legendary Cards

 	Eminence

 	Now begins scaling at 0ft.
 	"With the last round of Changes Lian has settled to a good spot, but Eminence is still under performing. Now players will get the effects of the card immediately."







https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Portrait_Maeve_50x50.jpg

 	Maeve

 	Daggers

 	Time between daggers reduced from 0.1 to 0.05
 	Projectile Size increased by 16%
 	Projectile Speed Increased from 260 to 400
 	Projectile Gravity Increased by 33%
 	"Maeve’s burst damage is undeniably powerful and her mobility is in a good spot right now, however the properties of Maeve’s weapon could make using it feel like a chore. With these changes players should be able to be more consistent with their deadly dagger throws."





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Ruckus.jpg

 	Ruckus

 	Missile Launcher

 	Projectile speed increased from 300 to 400.
 	Cooldown reduced from 10s to 8s.
 	"We feel that Ruckus’s gameplay is in a much better and clearer place now, but Missile Launcher could feel a little underwhelming, especially with the burden of aiming a projectile while aiming an instant-fire weapon. With these changes it will be more accessible and consistent."





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Pip.jpg

 	Pip

 	Weightless

 	Fixed a description issue that listed the duration of Weightless instead of 3s instead of 2.5s.
 	"Oops"





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/11/Profile-ShaLin.jpg

 	Sha Lin

 	Withdraw

 	No longer goes on cooldown until Sha Lin exits stealth.


 	Legendary Cards

 	Desert Shadow

 	Only grants increased damage to shots fired during stealth.
 	"With Sha Lin getting played more and more, some players would use Desert Shadow to preload an amplified shot then wait for withdraw to come off cooldown to create a one two punch. This change will resolve that unintended behavior."







https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Web_Forum_Profile_Strix_50x50.jpg


 	Strix

 	Talon Rifle

 	Damage reduced from 1300 to 1200.


 	Flash Bang

 	Augmented the blind effect to be less jarring.


 	Flare

 	Fixed a bug where flare was revealing enemies to Strix’s team, now only reveals enemies to Strix.


 	Stealth

 	Increased the initial energy cost of stealth by 65%
 	Reduced the Stealth energy charge rate by 20%
 	Increased the Minimum energy level required to enter stealth by 33%
 	"Strix released strong and made a big impact on the realm. He hits very hard while dying less than other damage champions. With these changes his damage output will be a little lower and he won’t be able to spend as much time in stealth."





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Tyra_Profile_Forum_50x50.png

 	Tyra

 	Legendary Cards

 	Hunting Party

 	Also reduces the cooldown of Hunter’s Mark by 2s.
 	"Hunting Party proved to be a lot of fun, but it felt like Tyra had to wait around for too long to use Hunter’s Mark again."







https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Profile_Willo_50x50.jpg

 	Willo

 	Dead Zone

 	Fixed a bug where Dead Zone’s description incorrectly indicated that the ability lasted 4 seconds instead of 5.


 	Fae Flight

 	Ultimate charge reduced by 16%.
 	"Willo had a relatively fast ultimate charge, and when combined with her ability to deal high area damage she could take to the skies multiple times per push phase. Now she’ll have to spend a little more time on the ground."





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/06/50x50Zhin.png

 	Zhin

 	Counter

 	Fixed a bug that caused a longer than intended lockout after countering an attack.
 	"It should feel better now."

Stay in touch with our Esports scene (coming later this fall) and correctly guess the winners of our upcoming matches for additional VIP Points.

 	50 Points per correct guess.

Complete your weekly quests for even more VIP Points.

 	100 Points per weekly quest completed.

VIP Membership
Players who purchase the VIP membership bundle will gain membership status which gives bonuses to VIP point gain for a period of time. We also have plans for other cosmetic benefits for VIP members. VIP members also get:

 	+100 Points per win (in addition to normal 50 points).
 	+35 Points per loss (in addition to normal 25 points).
 	+100 Points per correct esports pick (in addition to normal 50 points).
 	+400 points per weekly quest (in addition to normal 100 points).

Pricing
VIP Pack ($14.99)

 	Conqueror Zhin Collection
 	70 Day VIP Membership (5x 2-week memberships)
 	25 Radiant Chests
 	25 VIP Team Boosters
 	100,000 VIP Points

14 Day VIP Membership (200 Crystals)

 	5 Radiant Chests (250 Crystal value!)
 	20,000 VIP Points
 	5 VIP Match Boosters

VIP Points (70 Crystals)

 	10,000 VIP Points
 	Only Purchasable if VIP

Champions

 	Barik

 	General

 	New visual update to the Champion’s base model.
 	"Barik is getting a serious visual update this patch, addressing some art consistency and technical concerns. Our favorite little Master Mechanic got a new look that better reflects his personality and character in a way that ties him in better to our Paladins’ art style and fantasy theming. His trusty Blunderbuss and turrets are also getting a strong visual upgrade with model, animation, vfx, and audio improvements to reflect that wonderful Dwarven engineering. We are also giving Barik’s ultimate turret a unique model that reflects its importance and functionality."


 	Hi-Tek (old default skin)

 	Champion Skin + Weapon
 	Available for 1 Gold for a limited time






 	Cassie

 	Copacabana (Epic)

 	Champion skin + Voice Pack






 	Drogoz

 	Weapon: Samba Rocket Launcher




 	Fernando

 	FN-01 Erebos (Epic)

 	Champion skin + Weapon + Voice Pack + Spray






 	Jenos

 	Eclipse (Rare)

 	Champion skin
 	Weapon






 	Lex

 	Sarrada (Epic)

 	Champion skin + Voice Pack






 	Lian

 	Goddess (Epic)

 	Champion Skin + Weapon + Voice Pack + Spray






 	Kinessa

 	Weapon: Samba Sniper Rifle




 	Maeve

 	Raeve (Legendary)

 	Champion Skin + Weapon + Voice Pack + Spray






 	Ruckus

 	Ruckus B.E.T.A

 	Champion Skin is now 200 Crystals
 	Weapon is now 125 Crystals






 	Skye

 	Weapon: Samba Wristbow




 	Tyra

 	Weapon: Samba Auto Rifle




 	Zhin

 	Conqueror

Announcer Packs

 	Nick “Prettyhair” Koegh (VIP store only)
 	Evan “Raynday” Raynr (VIP store only)

Chests

Quests

Maps

 	Siege: Eastwatch




 	Bug fixes:

 	Brightmarsh

 	Added explosion cart particles
 	Raised cart destination vfx

 	General

 	Bulldozer

 	Cost reduced from 300 to 200.
 	"Because deployables generally have fairly low health, Bulldozer is actually very effective at what it does. However, 300 credits was still too high a price for the utility when compared to other Damage cards. With this change hopefully we’ll see Bulldozer picked up when a player cares about being able to quickly deal with pesky deployables."





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/08/ChampionPortrait_Jenos_50.jpg

 	Jenos

 	Celestial Touch

 	Healing reduced from 15% of maximum health to 10% of maximum health.
 	"Jenos has proven to be a very strong healer with his potential for very high throughput when picking cards to buff his team more often, for longer. However, with Celestial Touch Jenos had strong throughput and strong burst, which is too powerful of a combination."





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/ChampionPortrait_Lian_50.png

 	Lian

 	Legendary Cards

 	Eminence

 	Now begins scaling at 0ft.
 	"With the last round of Changes Lian has settled to a good spot, but Eminence is still under performing. Now players will get the effects of the card immediately."







https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Portrait_Maeve_50x50.jpg

 	Maeve

 	Daggers

 	Time between daggers reduced from 0.1 to 0.05
 	Projectile Size increased by 16%
 	Projectile Speed Increased from 260 to 400
 	Projectile Gravity Increased by 33%
 	"Maeve’s burst damage is undeniably powerful and her mobility is in a good spot right now, however the properties of Maeve’s weapon could make using it feel like a chore. With these changes players should be able to be more consistent with their deadly dagger throws."





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Ruckus.jpg

 	Ruckus

 	Missile Launcher

 	Projectile speed increased from 300 to 400.
 	Cooldown reduced from 10s to 8s.
 	"We feel that Ruckus’s gameplay is in a much better and clearer place now, but Missile Launcher could feel a little underwhelming, especially with the burden of aiming a projectile while aiming an instant-fire weapon. With these changes it will be more accessible and consistent."





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Pip.jpg

 	Pip

 	Weightless

 	Fixed a description issue that listed the duration of Weightless instead of 3s instead of 2.5s.
 	"Oops"





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/11/Profile-ShaLin.jpg

 	Sha Lin

 	Withdraw

 	No longer goes on cooldown until Sha Lin exits stealth.


 	Legendary Cards

 	Desert Shadow

 	Only grants increased damage to shots fired during stealth.
 	"With Sha Lin getting played more and more, some players would use Desert Shadow to preload an amplified shot then wait for withdraw to come off cooldown to create a one two punch. This change will resolve that unintended behavior."







https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Web_Forum_Profile_Strix_50x50.jpg


 	Strix

 	Talon Rifle

 	Damage reduced from 1300 to 1200.


 	Flash Bang

 	Augmented the blind effect to be less jarring.


 	Flare

 	Fixed a bug where flare was revealing enemies to Strix’s team, now only reveals enemies to Strix.


 	Stealth

 	Increased the initial energy cost of stealth by 65%
 	Reduced the Stealth energy charge rate by 20%
 	Increased the Minimum energy level required to enter stealth by 33%
 	"Strix released strong and made a big impact on the realm. He hits very hard while dying less than other damage champions. With these changes his damage output will be a little lower and he won’t be able to spend as much time in stealth."





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Tyra_Profile_Forum_50x50.png

 	Tyra

 	Legendary Cards

 	Hunting Party

 	Also reduces the cooldown of Hunter’s Mark by 2s.
 	"Hunting Party proved to be a lot of fun, but it felt like Tyra had to wait around for too long to use Hunter’s Mark again."







https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Profile_Willo_50x50.jpg

 	Willo

 	Dead Zone

 	Fixed a bug where Dead Zone’s description incorrectly indicated that the ability lasted 4 seconds instead of 5.


 	Fae Flight

 	Ultimate charge reduced by 16%.
 	"Willo had a relatively fast ultimate charge, and when combined with her ability to deal high area damage she could take to the skies multiple times per push phase. Now she’ll have to spend a little more time on the ground."





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/06/50x50Zhin.png

 	Zhin

 	Counter

 	Fixed a bug that caused a longer than intended lockout after countering an attack.
 	"It should feel better now."

notes.title: Open Beta 57 Patch Notes | Bird of Prey
notes.notes:
https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/08/ForumPost-PatchNotes-OB57-690x275-JT.jpg

Bird of Prey
Open Beta 57 Patch Notes | August 23rd
Beta Expectations

New Champion: Strix, Ghost Feather

 	Health: 2000
 	Abilities

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/08/Talon-RifleNEW.png [LMB1] Talon Rifle

A powerful rifle that fires one 1300 damage shot every second. Side Arm: A semi-automatic pistol that deals 250 damage per shot.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/08/ScopeNEW.png[RMB1] Scope

Look down your scope and gain pin point accuracy. Flare: Fire a flare that reveals enemies in a large radius.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/08/Side-ArmNEW.png[LMB2] Side Arm

A semi-automatic pistol that deals 250 damage per shot.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/08/FlareNEW.png[RMB2] Flare

Fire a flare that reveals enemies in a large radius.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/08/QuickSwitchNEW.pnghttps://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/08/QuickSwitch2NEW.png

[Q] Quick Switch

Switch to your other weapon.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/08/StealthNEW.png[F] Stealth

Enter stealth and hide yourself from vision. While in Stealth your energy is consumed.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/08/Flash-BangNEW.png[E] Flash Bang

Throw a Flash Bang grenade that detonate on contact blinding nearby enemies for 3 seconds
 

 	Legendaries

 	Nocturnal [Default]

 	[Stealth] Your Stealth bar consumes 50% slower


 	Ambush

 	[Stealth] Weapon Shots Made in stealth deal 15% more damage


 	Crack Shot

 	[Weapon] your side arm deals 20% more damage to targets that your sniper has damaged within 4s




 	Cards

 	Grizzled

 	[Armor] Gain 50/100/150/200 Health.


 	Trigger Control

 	[Weapon] Reduce Maximum Side Arm inaccuracy by 8/16/24/32%.


 	Infused Crystals

 	[Weapon] Increase the ammo count of both of your weapons by 1/2/3/4.


 	White Knuckle

 	[Weapon] Reduce Side Arm recoil by 20/40/60/80%.


 	Relentless

 	[Scope] Reduce the movement speed penalty of Scope by 25/50/75/100%.


 	Overburn

 	[Flare] Flare reveals for an additional 1/2/3/4s


 	Roost

 	[Scope] While stationary and in Scope, consume 8/16/24/32% less Stealth resource


 	Flare XL

 	[Flare] Increase the Reveal range of Flare by 20/40/60/80%.


 	Dexterous

 	[Quick Switch] Reduce the time to Swap to your Side arm by 20/40/60/80%.


 	Cooled Mags

 	[Quick Switch] Every 2 Seconds your inactive Weapon generates 2/4/6/8 Ammo


 	Bushwhack

 	[Quick Switch] Swapping to your Pistol grants 10/20/30/40% Lifesteal for 2s


 	Resourceful

 	[Quick Switch] Flare cools down 10/20/30/40% faster while your Side Arm is not active.


 	Stalker [Stealth]

 	Increase your Reload Speed by 10/20/30/40% while Stealthed.


 	Guerilla Tactics

 	[Stealth] Eliminations grant 15/30/40/60 Stealth Resource


 	Escape Plan

 	[Stealth] Entering stealth below 65% HP heals you for 100/200/300/400


 	Tactical Retreat

 	[Stealth] Gain 10/20/30/40% Movement Speed for 2s when entering stealth.






General

 	Added ‘Reticle Change Over Target’ setting to the Gameplay Options menu.
 	Added ‘Use Profanity Filter’ setting at the bottom of the Gameplay Options menu
 	The featured Champion during Top Play will now play a Top Play specific line. VGS will be blocked for all others but only during the intro and only while this Top Play voice line is playing.
 	When action is taken against a player that you have reported, there will be a message in the Notification Center and in chat.
 	Added automatic Vox callouts when being attacked.
 	New Champions will now be automatically banned in Competitive for 2 weeks.

General Bug Fixes

 	Fixed an issue with the the Kunoichi spray displaying the wrong image
 	Fixed an issue with the Quest reroll button not working

Ranked Bug Fixes

 	Fixed an issue where personal losses would always display as 25 at the top of the leaderboard.
 	Fixed a bug where players would not receive notification that they unlocked TerrorMorph Drogoz.


Customizations

 	Strix

 	Ghillie (Common)

 	Champion Skin
 	Weapon


 	Phoenix (Uncommon)

 	Champion Skin
 	Weapon


 	MISC

 	Voice Pack: Strix
 	Emote: 360 No Scope
 	MVP: Mission Accomplished





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/08/PatchPreview-Content-Strix-1024x576.jpg 

 	Viktor

 	V1-KTOR (Epic)

 	Champion Skin + Voice Pack
 	Weapon
 	Spray





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/08/Social-ESL-Viktor-1920x1080-JT-1024x576.jpg 

 	Lex

 	L-Exo Suit (Epic)

 	Champion Skin + Voice Pack
 	Weapon
 	Spray





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/08/PatchPreview-Content-Lex_SciFi-1024x576.jpg 

 	Inara

 	Sunstone (Uncommon)

 	Champion Skin + Weapon




 	Cassie

 	Obsidian and Cosmic

 	Champion Skin + Weapon




 	Inara

 	Obsidian and Cosmic

 	Champion Skin + Weapon






Chests

 	Deep Space Chest


Quests

 	Deep Space Spoils

 	Win 3 Siege games and be rewarded with a Deep Space Chest




Maps

 	Test Queue rotation

 	Add

 	Siege: Waterway




 	Bug fixes:

 	Fixed an issue where Jaguar Falls would display the incorrect map name in Practice
 	Fixed an issue on Frozen Guard where the user could get stuck outside the map




Champions

 	General

 	Improved the behavior of how Root and Void Grip detect what abilities they can interrupt and prevent.
“Root and Void Grip will now use the same logic as Cripple to determine what abilities they work against.”
 	Champions without a Reload can no longer buy Deft Hands.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Fernando.jpg
 	Fernando

 	Charge

 	Now passes through shields.
 	Cooldown increased from 8s to 10s.


 	Shield

 	Description updated to indicate that Shield lasts for 10s.


 	Fireball

 	No longer reduces healing.


 	Cards

 	Brand

 	Reworked
 	Fireball reduces healing by 20/40/60/80% for 3s.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/08/ChampionPortrait_Jenos_50.jpg
 	Jenos

 	Stellar Wind

 	Movement Speed reduced from 75% to 65%


 	Astral Mark

 	Healing reduced from 250 per second to 220 per second.



https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Steam_Profile_Lex_50.jpg
 	Lex

 	Magnums

 	Now semi-automatic, will no longer repeatedly fire when holding down LMB.
 	Time between shots reduced from 0.7s to 0.35s.
 	Damage reduced from 680 to 400.
 	Ammo count increased from 6 to 10
 	Now loses accuracy when fired repeatedly.
 	Animations updated so that one gun can be finishing the fire animation as the other gun fires.


 	Legendary Cards

 	Heroism

 	Reworked
 	Gain 90% Damage Reduction and CC Immunity while using Combat Slide.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/ChampionPortrait_Lian_50.png
 	Lian

 	Legendary Cards

 	Precision

 	No longer grants increased damage.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Portrait_Maeve_50x50.jpg
 	Maeve

 	Weapon

 	Fixed a bug where Maeve's weapons would fire slightly slower at lower framerates.



https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Makoa.jpg
 	Makoa

 	Dredge Anchor

 	Fixed a bug where shooting your weapon before hooking someone could cancel the hook.



https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Pip.jpg
 	Pip

 	Cards

 	Reload

 	Updated text to indicate that Reload does not activate when Pip heals himself.


 	Pep in the Step

 	Fixed a bug where this card could increase Pip’s movement speed.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Ruckus.jpg
 	Ruckus

 	Repulsor Field

 	Removed from the game.


 	Emitter

 	Moved from Altfire (Right Mouse) to Ability 1 (Q)


 	Missile Launcher

 	New ability
 	Fire two missiles that deal 250 damage each in a large area.


 	Cards

 	Metal March

 	Reworked
 	[Missile Launcher] Gain 5/10/15/20% damage reduction for 3s after activating Missile Launcher.


 	At the ready

 	Reworked
 	[Missile Launcher] Hitting an enemy with Missile Launcher reveals them for 1/2/3/4s.


 	Crystal Capacitor

 	Reworked
 	[Missile Launcher] Reduce the Cooldown of Missile Launcher by .5/1/1.5/2s.


 	Opulence

 	Reworked
 	[Missile Launcher] Heal for 75/150/225/300 health when activating Missile Launcher.




 	Legendary Cards

 	Flux Generator

 	Reworked
 	Increase the Shielding from Emitter by 50%.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Skye.jpg
 	Skye

 	Poison Bolts

 	Duration Reduced from 5s to 4s
 	Tick frequency increased from 1s to 0.2s
 	Damage is now .5% per tick but still 10% over the duration of each poison bolt
 	No longer reduces healing.


 	Legendary Cards

 	Surprise Attack

 	Damage increased from 300 to 500.


 	Debilitate

 	Reworked
 	Poison Bolts DoT now deals 33% more damage twice as fast.




 	Cards

 	Decrepify

 	Reworked
 	Poison Bolts reduce healing by 20/40/60/80% for 3s.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Ying.jpg
 	Ying

 	Dimensional Link

 	Added UI indicator for targeting specific illusions to swap places with.


 	Illusory Rift

 	No longer spawns deployables.
 	Now applies a global buff on all allies that heals them for 600 health per second for 8 seconds.
 	While Illusory Rift is active Dimensional Link can now teleport you to any ally.

notes.notes:
https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/08/ForumPost-PatchNotes-OB56-JT-1.jpg

Way of the Warrior
Open Beta 56 Patch Notes | August 9th

Beta Expectations

General

 	Added custom animations for weapon inspection for all Champions (G key or R3 click in)
 	Custom game creation menu improvements

 	Added new menu for 1st selecting game mode, then map
 	Added Spectator Password option


 	Added Restore to Default button in Options menu for Audio, Gameplay, Controls, Bindings, and Spectator
 	Improved presentation at end of match for rewards
 	Added Scope Sensitivity setting in Options menu to set the sensitivity of Kinessa's scope
 	Disabling reticle bloom now sets the reticle to the smallest size

GENERAL BUG FIXES

 	Fixed an issue where Gold Team bonus was not applying properly
 	Fixed an issue where user’s couldn’t purchase Boosters after purchasing a Champion
 	Fixed an issue with Opt-In emails
 	Fixed an issue where Drogoz Thrust description was incorrect
 	Fixed issue with Jenos Stellar Wind in Spectate
 	Fixed an issue where gamepad sensitivity was being modified inaccurately by FOV


Ranked 2.0

Paladins Competitive has been built up from our BETA ranked test system into a tiered system in which players clash to climb the ranks from Bronze to Grandmaster and earn Ranked-exclusive rewards.

There are 7 Tiers in Ranked 2.0

 	Bronze
 	Silver
 	Gold
 	Platinum
 	Diamond
 	Master
 	Grandmaster

Bronze through Diamond each have 5 Divisions within their Tiers. Playing Competitive now earns you Triumph Points (TP). Earning enough TP will promote you from your current division. Master is the highest division that can be reached this way and from there, the 100 players with the most TP are placed into the Grandmaster Division.

Entering Ranked

Before playing Ranked games a player must be level 15 and own at least 12 characters. There are no mastery level requirements for those characters.

New Players will have to play 15 qualifying games before they are placed within a division. Their placement will be based on performance in their qualifying games.

Partying

If you are placed in Bronze, Silver, Gold, or Platinum you may now form up to a five-man party to play competitive games but only if all partied members are also in Bronze, Silver, Gold, or Platinum.

Players in Diamond, Master, and Grandmaster may only duo-queue into Competitive games. Diamond players may duo-queue with players in Platinum, Diamond, Masters, or Grandmaster. Master and Grandmaster players may only duo queue with players in Diamond, Master, or Grandmaster.

Qualifying players may duo-queue with each other or players in Bronze, Silver, Gold, or Platinum to other enter their Qualifiers.

Ranked Progression

Winning Competitive games now earns you TP. If you reach 100 TP you are promoted to a higher division and your TP is set back to 0. Excess points carry over into your new division. Exceptional performance may allow you to skip forward a few divisions when promoted.

Losing Competitive games will lower your TP. If you lose a Competitive game when at 0 TP you will be demoted to a lower division. You can not be demoted this way until you play at least 5 games within your division. Players are set to 70TP when demoted.

Rewards

As you play ranked you may receive special rewards exclusive to the ranked season.

 	Qualify for Ranked to receive a loading frame that displays your highest reached division in the current split.
 	Qualify for Ranked to receive a Champion Skin Chest Roll.
 	Play 25 Competitive games to receive a Weapon Chest Roll.
 	Reach the Gold 5 Division to receive the Epic Drogoz Skin Set: Terrormorph.
 	Win 100 Competitive games to receive the Epic Drogoz Weapon: Terrormorph’s Maw.
 	Win 200 Competitive games to receive the “Forged in Battle” title.
 	End the Season placed in Grandmaster or in the top 3 spots of any Champion Leaderboard to receive Crystals as a reward.

Champions

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Androxus.jpg
 	Androxus

 	Now also increases ultimate charge rate by 15%.

 	Now also grants 15% increased damage while Recovery is active.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Cassie.jpg
 	Cassie

 	Legendary Cards

 	Exaction

 	Damage bonus reduced from 40% to 30%.

 	“While most of our changes were to underused legendary cards, Exaction was a unique case. Despite Cassie’s other options performing well, Exaction was used the vast majority of the time. This card was clearly over-budget in how much damage it was contributing to Cassie’s kit.”







https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/08/ChampionPortrait_Jenos_50.jpg
 	Jenos

 	Health reduced from 2600 to 2400.

 	“Jenos has been performing very well, he’s keeping his teams alive and dealing damage where it counts. However, his greatest strength currently is how hard he is to kill. We like that Jenos is slippery, but we want him to be in a little more danger when he’s been caught.”


 	Cards

 	Sidereal

 	Fixed a bug where this card was applying incorrect VFX.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Steam_Profile_Lex_50.jpg
 	Lex

 	Retribution

 	No longer reveals stealthed targets.

 	“With the recent buffs to the Discovery legendary, we felt it was too easy for Lex players to completely nullify the effects of stealth. You’ll still be able to track Stealthed characters when they’re on cooldown, ensuring that they don’t have time to rest, but now they have a chance to get the jump on you.”




 	Legendary Cards

 	Heroism

 	Attack speed increased from 25% to 35%.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/ChampionPortrait_Lian_50.png
 	Lian

 	Cards

 	Shining Topaz

 	Fixed a bug where this card was applying incorrect VFX.




 	Legendary Cards

 	Eminence

 	Now starts dealing bonus damage at 50 ft instead of 100 ft.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Grover.jpg
 	Grover

 	Throwing Axe

 	Prefire reduced from 0.3s to 0.2s
 	Postfire reduced from 0.8s to 0.7s
 	Damage reduced from 400 to 330.

 	“The Root of the Grover experience is his big axe hits from long range, strong enough to Chop down even Ash or womp Willow out of the Skye. While Elder players were resting on their Laurels, Sapling Grover players were Pining for a Spruced up weapon experience. With this change Grover won’t delay his Axe throws as much, allowing him to be more consistent. Let us know what Yew think!”




 	Whirlwind

 	Fixed a bug where Whirlwind could heal deployable shields.

 	“Grover is weird, but we felt this was a little too strange.”





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Makoa.jpg
 	Makoa

 	Dredge Anchor

 	Fixed a bug where Makoa could spin to trap players in the hook for longer than intended. Makoa’s pull will no longer update its endpoint once the target is within 8 ft of Makoa.

 	“This change is only meant to remove the ability to spin players indefinitely. You will still be able to pull off 180° no scope hooks to throw your opponents off a ledge.”




 	Cards

 	Ebb and Flow

 	Fixed an issue where Makoa’s Ebb and Flow IV didn’t have a proper internal cooldown





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Ruckus.jpg
 	Ruckus

 	Miniguns

 	Spin up time reduced from 3s to 1s.
 	Damage reduced from 53 to 48.

 	“One of the best ways to reduce Ruckus’ damage output was constantly forcing him to spin down, and Ruckus players would often spend all game shooting just so they never had to spin back up. This felt strange and unintuitive, so now Ruckus can spin up his miniguns a little faster.”





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Seris_50x50.jpg
 	Seris

 	Soul Orb

 	No longer required to hold firing input for the first orb to shoot out



https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/11/Profile-ShaLin.jpg
 	Sha Lin

 	Reduced the amount Sha Lin is slowed while drawing his bow from 30% to 10%.

 	“Sha Lin had started to lag behind other damage characters. With this change, he’s got a little bit more pep in his step.”



https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Skye.jpg
 	Skye

 	Health increased from 1800 to 2000.

 	“The range changes to Skye’s weapon helped her be a little more versatile and a little less extreme. As a result it is no longer necessary for her to be such a glass cannon, she’ll now be able to take a little bit more damage before going down.”



https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Profile_Willo_50x50.jpg
 	Willo

 	Legendary Cards

 	Scorched Earth

 	Now also reduces the cooldown of Dead Zone by 3s.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Ying.jpg
 	Ying

 	Illusory Mirror

 	Refire time reduced from 0.7s to 0.5s
 	Time between shots reduced from 0.1s to 0.05s
 	Ammo Count increased from 6 to 8
 	Damage per shot reduced from 120 to 90
 	Updated VFX and Sound to improve weapon experience

 	“Ying’s weapon was strong when used well but unintuitive for many players. Now with a faster refire and a quicker burst it should feel a little more snappy and consistent.”




 	Legendary Cards

 	Focusing Lens

 	Bonus Damage reduced from 200 to 150


 	“Because Ying is now firing faster and more consistently, the values of Focusing Lens had to be reduced. We still expect this card to be stronger than it was in previous patches.”

 	“This patch we’ve made a pass to improve on underused or underperforming legendary cards. These changes should make these cards more enticing, and we will continue to monitor them in future patches.”

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Androxus.jpg
 	Androxus

 	Cards

 	Watchful

 	Fixed a bug where this card was applying incorrect VFX.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/05/50x50Ash.png
 	Ash

 	Legendary Cards

 	Rally Here

 	Now also increases ultimate charge rate by 15%.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Barik.jpg
 	Barik

 	Turret

 	No longer detects stealth.


 	Legendary Cards

 	Fortify

 	Now also reduces the cooldown of Barricade by 3s.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Buck.jpg
 	Buck

 	Legendary Cards

 	Bulk Up

 	Now also grants 15% increased damage while Recovery is active.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Cassie.jpg
 	Cassie

 	Legendary Cards

 	Exaction

 	Damage bonus reduced from 40% to 30%.

 	“While most of our changes were to underused legendary cards, Exaction was a unique case. Despite Cassie’s other options performing well, Exaction was used the vast majority of the time. This card was clearly over-budget in how much damage it was contributing to Cassie’s kit.”







https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/08/ChampionPortrait_Jenos_50.jpg
 	Jenos

 	Health reduced from 2600 to 2400.

 	“Jenos has been performing very well, he’s keeping his teams alive and dealing damage where it counts. However, his greatest strength currently is how hard he is to kill. We like that Jenos is slippery, but we want him to be in a little more danger when he’s been caught.”


 	Cards

 	Sidereal

 	Fixed a bug where this card was applying incorrect VFX.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Steam_Profile_Lex_50.jpg
 	Lex

 	Retribution

 	No longer reveals stealthed targets.

 	“With the recent buffs to the Discovery legendary, we felt it was too easy for Lex players to completely nullify the effects of stealth. You’ll still be able to track Stealthed characters when they’re on cooldown, ensuring that they don’t have time to rest, but now they have a chance to get the jump on you.”




 	Legendary Cards

 	Heroism

 	Attack speed increased from 25% to 35%.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/ChampionPortrait_Lian_50.png
 	Lian

 	Cards

 	Shining Topaz

 	Fixed a bug where this card was applying incorrect VFX.




 	Legendary Cards

 	Eminence

 	Now starts dealing bonus damage at 50 ft instead of 100 ft.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Grover.jpg
 	Grover

 	Throwing Axe

 	Prefire reduced from 0.3s to 0.2s
 	Postfire reduced from 0.8s to 0.7s
 	Damage reduced from 400 to 330.

 	“The Root of the Grover experience is his big axe hits from long range, strong enough to Chop down even Ash or womp Willow out of the Skye. While Elder players were resting on their Laurels, Sapling Grover players were Pining for a Spruced up weapon experience. With this change Grover won’t delay his Axe throws as much, allowing him to be more consistent. Let us know what Yew think!”




 	Whirlwind

 	Fixed a bug where Whirlwind could heal deployable shields.

 	“Grover is weird, but we felt this was a little too strange.”





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Makoa.jpg
 	Makoa

 	Dredge Anchor

 	Fixed a bug where Makoa could spin to trap players in the hook for longer than intended. Makoa’s pull will no longer update its endpoint once the target is within 8 ft of Makoa.

 	“This change is only meant to remove the ability to spin players indefinitely. You will still be able to pull off 180° no scope hooks to throw your opponents off a ledge.”




 	Cards

 	Ebb and Flow

 	Fixed an issue where Makoa’s Ebb and Flow IV didn’t have a proper internal cooldown





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Ruckus.jpg
 	Ruckus

 	Miniguns

 	Spin up time reduced from 3s to 1s.
 	Damage reduced from 53 to 48.

 	“One of the best ways to reduce Ruckus’ damage output was constantly forcing him to spin down, and Ruckus players would often spend all game shooting just so they never had to spin back up. This felt strange and unintuitive, so now Ruckus can spin up his miniguns a little faster.”





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Seris_50x50.jpg
 	Seris

 	Soul Orb

 	No longer required to hold firing input for the first orb to shoot out



https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/11/Profile-ShaLin.jpg
 	Sha Lin

 	Reduced the amount Sha Lin is slowed while drawing his bow from 30% to 10%.

 	“Sha Lin had started to lag behind other damage characters. With this change, he’s got a little bit more pep in his step.”



https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Skye.jpg
 	Skye

 	Health increased from 1800 to 2000.

 	“The range changes to Skye’s weapon helped her be a little more versatile and a little less extreme. As a result it is no longer necessary for her to be such a glass cannon, she’ll now be able to take a little bit more damage before going down.”



https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Profile_Willo_50x50.jpg
 	Willo

 	Legendary Cards

 	Scorched Earth

 	Now also reduces the cooldown of Dead Zone by 3s.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Ying.jpg
 	Ying

 	Illusory Mirror

 	Refire time reduced from 0.7s to 0.5s
 	Time between shots reduced from 0.1s to 0.05s
 	Ammo Count increased from 6 to 8
 	Damage per shot reduced from 120 to 90
 	Updated VFX and Sound to improve weapon experience

 	“Ying’s weapon was strong when used well but unintuitive for many players. Now with a faster refire and a quicker burst it should feel a little more snappy and consistent.”




 	Legendary Cards

 	Focusing Lens

 	Bonus Damage reduced from 200 to 150


 	“Because Ying is now firing faster and more consistently, the values of Focusing Lens had to be reduced. We still expect this card to be stronger than it was in previous patches.”

notes.title: Open Beta 55 Patch Notes | Celestial Uprising
notes.notes:
https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/OB55-ForumPost-PatchNotes.jpg
Celestial Uprising
Open Beta 55 Patch Notes | July 26th
Beta Expectations

New Champion: Jenos, the Ascended

 	Jenos is our newest Support who has descended from his mountaintop home to confront the aggressors of the world below. He soars through the battlefield with 2600 Health utilizing his long lasting heals, powerful setups, and devastating finishers to turn the tide of battle.
 	Abilities

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Ability_Jenos_Weapon.jpg [LMB] Star Splitter

An otherworldly weapon that channels the power of the stars. Deals 120 damage every 0.13s at medium range.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Ability_Jenos_AstralMark.jpg [RMB] Astral Mark

Apply a celestial blessing through all obstacles, healing for 250 Health every second for 10 seconds.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Ability_Jenos_VoidGrip.jpg [Q] Void Grip

Channel gravitational energy and lift an enemy up, dealing 150 damage every second for 2.5s. If the victim manages to move while lifted it will interrupt Void Grip.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Ability_Jenos_StellarWind.jpg [F] Stellar Wind

Lower your weapon and move 75% faster while increasing your jump height and lowering your fall speed.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Ability_Jenos_ThroughTimeAndSpace.jpg [E] Through Time and Space

Lock yourself in place and gather the power of the cosmos for 1.5s becoming CC immune, then unleash your energy in a long range blast that pierces through all obstacles and deals 2400 damage.


 	Legendaries

 	The Power Cosmeum [Default]

 	[Void Grip] Enemies affected by Void Grip are crippled and take an additional 150 damage per second.


 	Luminary

 	[Astral Mark] You and allies who are affected by Astral Mark deal 15% more weapon damage.


 	Celestial Touch

 	[Astral Mark] When you cast Astral Mark on an ally, they are immediately healed for 15% of their Maximum Health.




 	Cards

 	Sidereal

 	[Weapon] Weapon attacks reveal enemies to you for 1/2/3/4 seconds.


 	Inertia

 	[Armor] You cannot be slowed below 50/60/70/80% of your base movement speed.


 	Penumbra

 	[Weapon] Gain 8/16/24/32% Lifesteal.


 	Lorentz Configuration

 	[Weapon] Increase your ammo count by 2/4/6/8.


 	Eclipse

 	[Void Grip] Enemies affected by Void Grip receive 20/40/60/80% reduced healing.


 	Heavenly Pull

 	[Void Grip] Increase the Range you can use Void Grip by 10/20/30/40%.


 	Inner Peace

 	[Void Grip] Decrease the cooldown of Void Grip by 1/2/3/4s.


 	Falling Star

 	[Void Grip] If a victim of Void Grip dies within 4s of being hit by the ability, reduce all active cooldowns by 15/30/45/60%.


 	Lightyears

 	[Astral Mark] Increase Astral Mark's range by 10/20/30/40%.


 	Retrograde

 	[Astral Mark] Reduce the Cooldown of Astral Mark by 0.5/1/1.5/2s.


 	Relativity

 	[Astral Mark] Applying Astral Mark heals you for 40/80/120/160 Health per second over 10 seconds.


 	Astral Cycle

 	[Astral Mark] Increase the duration of Astral Mark by 0.5/1/1.5/2s.


 	Star Seeker

 	[Stellar Wind] Increase air control by 10/20/30/40% while using Stellar Wind.


 	Solar Sails

 	[Stellar Wind] Gain 2/4/6/8 ammo per second during Stellar Wind.


 	Cosmic Barrier

 	[Stellar Wind] Gain 8/16/24/32% damage reduction while using Stellar Wind.


 	Space Jam

 	[Stellar Wind] Increase your jump height by 12/24/36/48% while using Stellar Wind.






GENERAL

 	Legendary Enchanted Key Option for Radiant Chests

“We are introducing a new Enchanted Key option for Radiant Chests. In addition to the previously existing Enchant option, players will now be able to use a key that guarantees no duplicate items and at least 1 Legendary.”

 	Free Champions are now: Cassie, Fernando, Pip, Skye, and Viktor
 	Added a Champion Rotation
 	This week’s Free Champions are: Ruckus, Drogoz, Lex and Ying.

“With 0.55 we are adding a weekly champion rotation. On top of the static 5 free champions, players will be able to play 4 additional champions. Each week 2 of the 4 champions on rotation will change. Cards, cosmetic items, and masteries earned for those champions will be available when those champions are unlocked or next on rotation. Players who played before 0.55 will continue to have champions that were previously free unlocked.”

 	New Quest

 	A Clockwork Heart
Win 5 games and be rewarded with a Clockwork Chest. This quest will replace the Summer Fun quest.



GENERAL BUG FIXES

 	Custom Matches are now sorted Alphabetically by Lobby Name
 	Fixed issue where switching classes multiple times in Shooting Range would disable Legendary card effects
 	Fixed an issue where Legendaries or Loadouts couldn’t be selected when loading late into the start of a match
 	Fixed issue where Evie could Blink while Rooted
 	Fixed Sprays not equipping properly in Match Lobby
 	Fixed issue with Lian’s Grace drawing two firing traces
 	Fixed instance with Lian’s Legendaries not showing properly on entering match
 	Fixed captured waypoint icon saying persisting on screen for too long
 	Fixed missing text for Founder’s Pack Essence acquisition
 	Fixed end of match lobby chat disappearing right after a match ends
 	Fixed issue with players who didn’t receive account level 30 beta Achievement from OB53 adjustments
 	Fixed end of match reward issues with Onslaught Practice
 	Small clean ups in the items section of the store.
 	Shooting Range

 	Fixed issue with all Champion Emotes playing Viktor’s.
 	Fixed not being able to use non-default Emotes
 	Fixed unable to use Sprays




CUSTOMIZATIONS

Champions

 	Jenos

 	Capricorn (Common)

 	Champion skin
 	Weapon


 	Millennium (Uncommon)

 	Champion skin
 	Weapon


 	MISC

 	Voice Pack: Jenos
 	Emote: Parting Gift
 	MVP: Almighty




 	Mal’Damba

 	Defiler (Rare)

 	Champion skin
 	Weapon





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/ESL-Blog-MalDamba-Defiler-1024x576.jpg

 	Ruckus

 	New visual update to the champion’s base model

 	Bringing his base more in line with the fantasy style of the game and to better match his backstory and lore
 	The visual rework also includes a lot of significant, targeted FPS performance improvements for the champion


 	B.E.T.A. (old default skin)

 	Champion Skin + Weapon
 	Available for 1 Gold for a limited time




 	Torvald

 	General

 	Changed his Accessory from Spectacles to Rucksack

 	Historian's Rucksack (Common)
 	Cartography Rucksack (Common)
 	Arcanist's Rucksack (Common, Exclusive)




 	Clockwork (Epic)

 	Champion Skin + Voice Pack
 	Weapon

 	Obsidian

 	Champion Skin + Weapon


 	Cosmic

 	Champion Skin + Weapon


 	MISC

 	Emote: Mastery
 	MVP: Mastery
 	Spray: Mastery









https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Patch-Preview-Content-Torvald-Clockwork-1024x576.jpg

 	Willo

 	Hemlock (Epic)

 	Champion Skin + Voice Pack
 	Weapon





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/ESL-Blog-Willo-DarkEmber-1024x576.jpg 

 	Ying

 	Obsidian

 	Champion Skin + Weapon


 	Cosmic

 	Champion Skin + Weapon


 	MISC

 	Emote: Mastery
 	MVP: Mastery
 	Spray: Mastery





The following have been added to the Champion Skin and Weapon Chests:

 	Replicant
 	Replicant’s Reflection
 	Viceroy
 	Viceroy Wand
 	Pandamonium

The following have been added to the Flair Chest:

 	Gunshow
 	Showman

Discount Rates on Common and Uncommon Champion Skins have changed to reflect their new prices:

 	Common Head Discount: 25 Crystals | 7,125 Gold
 	Common Body Discount: 25 Crystals | 7,125 Gold
 	Uncommon Head Discount: 25 Crystals | 11,250 Gold
 	Uncommon Body Discount: 50 Crystals | 11,250 Gold


CHESTS

 	Clockwork Chest


MAPS

 	New Siege map: Splitstone Quarry
 	Environment Art

 	“We are bringing a whole new art set and visual look to the Realm with our latest siege map, Splitstone Quarry. Set deep in a large scale gold mining operation it was an opportunity to explore a more industrial setting. It also allowed us to showcase an area that ties heavily into the backstories of a couple of our champions and introduce new types of environmental hazards.”


 	Level Design

 	"Splitstone Quarry's capture point is cut into the deepest section of the quarry and forces players to defend from above while contesting the objective. While there are quick side routes, flankers will have to watch out for dangerous environmental hazards. The payload must be pushed through a corridor that emphasizes long range firefights.”



https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/DFSO__-W0AE_gW5-1024x576.jpg 

 	Added Brightmarsh and Jaguar Falls to the rotation of Onslaught maps
 	Test Queue rotation

 	Remove

 	Tilted


 	Add

 	Shade (Onslaught)






CHAMPIONS

 	General

 	All champions are now immune to damage when in a base healing volume.
 	Ultimates are no longer usable in a base healing volume.
 	All Emotes will now lock players out of all actions, including movement for 2s. Emotes may be interrupted at any time after the 2s lockout.



“We think it’s really cool that players can emote to enter 3rd person with free rotation whenever they want, however, emoting had too many gameplay advantages without any risk. Players could use emotes to look around corners with very little risk. Now, emoting will be a little more risky, but there will be no benefit to using shorter emotes.”

 	https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Barik.jpg
 	Barik

 	Cards

 	Failsafe

 	Will no longer go on cooldown when Rocket Boots are already available.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Buck.jpg
 	Buck

 	Net Shot

 	Cooldown reduced from 14s to 12s.



https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Cassie.jpg
 	Cassie

 	Cards

 	Somersault

 	Will no longer go on cooldown when Dodge Roll is already available.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Drogoz.jpg
 	Drogoz

 	Fire Spit

 	Reduced range at which falloff starts from 70% of the effect radius to 50% of the effect radius.


 	Cards

 	Survival

 	Will no longer go on cooldown when Thrust is already available.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Evie.jpg
 	Evie

 	Blink

 	This ability should be more responsive in a high ping environment.



https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Fernando.jpg
 	Fernando

 	Maximum health reduced from 5500 to 5000.
 	Cards

 	Unstoppable Force

 	Fixed a bug where Unstoppable Force’s knockback was not applying its full knockback value.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Grohk.jpg
 	Grohk

 	Shock Pulse

 	No longer hits stealthed targets.



https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Grover.jpg
 	Grover

 	Maximum health reduced from 3000 to 2700.
 	Cards

 	Over Growth

 	Will no longer go on cooldown when Vine is already available.




 	Whirlwind

 	Fixed a rendering issue



https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Kinessa.png
 	Kinessa

 	Teleporter

 	This ability should be more responsive in a high ping environment.



https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Makoa.jpg
 	Makoa

 	Cannon

 	Cannon

 	Increased minimum damage at maximum falloff from 30% to 40%.




 	Ancient Rage

 	Melee swings during Ancient Rage now act as a weapon attack.


 	Cards

 	Ebb and Flow

 	Will no longer go on cooldown when Shell Spin is already available.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Steam_Profile_Lex_50.jpg
 	Lex

 	Cards

 	Requip

 	Will no longer go on cooldown when Lex has full ammo.


 	Restock

 	Will no longer go on cooldown when Lex has full ammo.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/ChampionPortrait_Lian_50.png
 	Lian

 	General

 	[Lian][2d Art] Legendary card art not showing in match unless first viewed from Champion loadouts
 	Fixed camera reload issue when using Deft Hands



https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/11/Profile-ShaLin.jpg
 	Sha Lin

 	Impaler Arrow

 	Fixed an issue that caused the knockback and stun of this ability to work inconsistently.
“Impaler arrow is a fun ability and one of the best tools in Sha Lin’s arsenal, but it has suffered from some inconsistency. We’ve spent some time working to improve the function of this ability so it should work much more consistently across a variety of circumstances”



https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Skye.jpg
 	Skye

 	Wrist Crossbow

 	Reduced maximum inaccuracy from 90% to 94%.
 	Increased minimum damage at maximum falloff from 15% to 30%.
 	Reduced range at which maximum falloff occurs from 120ft to 100ft.
 	Reduced damage from 150 to 140.
“Currently, Skye has the highest damage potential in the game, with a weapon that gets much weaker over distance. Now she’ll see a little less damage up close, but her weapon will be much more versatile and consistent.”


 	Cards

 	Emergency Exit

 	Will no longer go on cooldown when already Stealthed.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Viktor.jpg
 	Viktor

 	Assault Rifle

 	Ammo count increased from 25 to 30.


 	Frag Grenade

 	Self damage reduced from 250 to 100.
 	Effect radius increased from 25 to 30.



https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/06/50x50Zhin.png
 	Zhin

 	Counter

 	Damage over Time damage ticks can no longer be Countered.

“With 0.55 we are adding a weekly champion rotation. On top of the static 5 free champions, players will be able to play 4 additional champions. Each week 2 of the 4 champions on rotation will change. Cards, cosmetic items, and masteries earned for those champions will be available when those champions are unlocked or next on rotation. Players who played before 0.55 will continue to have champions that were previously free unlocked.”

Win 5 games and be rewarded with a Clockwork Chest. This quest will replace the Summer Fun quest.

notes.notes:
https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/OB54-Launcher-Large-PatchNotes.jpg
Ice and Gunfire
Open Beta 54 Patch Notes | July 12th
Beta Expectations

New Champion: Lian, Scion of House Aico

 	Role: Damage
 	Health: 2000
 	Abilities

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Lian_Rifle80.png[LMB] Heirloom Rifle

A rifle that has been passed down through your noble house through the ages. Deals 400 damage every 0.45s at medium range.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Lian_Valor80.png[RMB] Valor

Fire a charged shot dealing 400 damage to all enemies in front of you. Acts as a weapon attack.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Lian_Presence80.png[Q] Presence

Charge your rifle for 0.5s then fire a long range shot that pierces enemies and deals 800 damage. Acts as a weapon attack.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Lian_Grace80.png[F] Grace

Quickly dodge in the direction you are moving and fire a rifle a shot dealing 400 damage to the enemy nearest to where you are aiming. Acts as a weapon attack.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Lian_Grace8080.png[E] Enlightenment

Channel the power of your noble blood to gain damage and CC immunity for 1s then fire a powerful blast that passes through enemies and deals 1600 damage. Killing an enemy with Enlightenment will refund 50% of your ultimate charge.
 

 	Legendaries

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Talent_Lian_Eminence.pngEminence [Default]

[Presence] Presence deals up to 50% more damage past 100 feet., and its Cooldown is reduced by 4s.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Talent_Lian_Alacrity-1.pngAlacrity

[Grace] Grace now hits all enemies in front you instead of only one, and its Cooldown is reduced by 1s.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Talent_Lian_Precision.pngPrecision

[Rifle] Deal 10% more damage with your rifle, and Grace generates 8 ammo.
 

 	Cards

 	Noble Crest

 	[Armor] Gain 50/100/150/200 Health.


 	Inheritance

 	[Armor] Eliminations reduce all cooldowns by 10/20/30/40%.


 	Highborn

 	[Armor] Gain 5/10/15/20% Movement Speed.


 	Superiority

 	[Armor] You cannot be slowed below 50/60/70/80%.


 	Eagle's Emerald

 	[Valor] Headshots reduce the Cooldown of Valor by 1/2/3/4s.


 	Revitalizing Gem

 	[Valor] Heal for 30/60/90/120 for every enemy hit with Valor.


 	Swift Jade

 	[Valor] Reduce the Cooldown of Grace by .5/1/1.5/2s for every enemy hit with Valor.


 	Shining Topaz

 	[Valor] Valor reveals enemies for 1/2/3/4s.


 	Signet Ring

 	[Presence] Gain 10/20/30/40% movement speed for 3s when using Presence.


 	Royal Seal

 	[Presence] Presence reduces healing by 50% for 1/2/3/4s.


 	Heraldry

 	[Presence] Hitting an enemy with Presence reduces its cooldown by 1.5/3/4.5/6s.


 	Present Arms

 	[Presence] Heal for 75/150/225/300 health after using Presence.


 	Heir to the Throne

 	[Grace] Move 10/20/30/40% faster during Grace.


 	Bloodline

 	[Grace] Heal for 50/100/150/200 Health after using Grace.


 	Divine Right

 	[Grace] Gain 10/20/30/40% movement Speed for 2s after using Grace.


 	Manifest Destiny

GENERAL

 	Added preview of map selection


 	Added new Acquisition notifications to Activity Center like Realm Pack and awarded Chests.
 	Added Filter by Champion in the Store.
 	Added new setting Toggle Zoom in Options > Gameplay for Iron Sights (Viktor) & Scope (Kinessa) to be toggled instead of held.

GENERAL BUG FIXES
Fixed Draft Mode match lobby where other players selecting Champions would close your Champion view after locking in.
Fixed 7-Day Booster acquisition showing incorrect count.
Fixed Mastery skins not equipping after unlocking from the Champion Overview.
Fixed Champions initially appearing locked after purchasing (Visual only).



GAME MODES
General

Onslaught

CUSTOMIZATIONS

 	Champion skin
 	Weapon

 	Champion skin
 	Weapon

 	Weapon





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/ESL-Blog-TyraDireWolf-1024x576.jpg .

 	Weapon





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/ESL-Blog-InaraIceQueen-1-1024x576.jpg 

Announcer Packs

ECONOMY AND PROGRESSION

“At present, cards are too difficult to unlock. It’s always been our goal to offer meaningful character progression as you play Paladins, but as we have been listening to feedback and monitoring our data, it is clear that the time necessary to acquire cards is too long.

This Patch we will be addressing this issue from a few different angles. Players will be earning chests at an accelerated rate along with lower crafting costs (without a reduction in duplicate values), New avenues to earn essence, and a 60% increase in weekly quest gold rewards. Having a healthy economy is a balancing act and gold costs of cosmetic items and Champions will be increasing.”

 	Radiant Chest Cosmetic Drop Rates

 	Increased the Drop Rates of Cosmetics in Radiant Chests by 33%


 	The experience required per player level between levels 1 and 50 has been Reduced.

 	Previously experience requirements would cap out 1 million experience per level at level 30, now that cap is met at level 50.
 	As a result, almost all players will see their level increase and levels between 1 and 50 will require on average 35% less experience.


 	Card Crafting

 	Essence Cost Reduction

 	Legendary: 12,000 to 10,000
 	Epics: 5,000 to 4,000
 	Uncommon: 1,250 to 1,000
 	Common: 500 to 350




 	Daily login bonus:

 	Give 250 essence at Day 4 (instead of 350g)
 	Give 500 essence at Day 5 (instead of 500g)
 	Give 1,000 essence at Day 6 (instead of 15 crystals)


 	Weekly Quest Reward Increases and Addition of Essence

 	Cry Havok!

 	Now rewards 1250 Gold and requires 5 games played as a Damage champion.


 	Hold the Front

 	Now rewards 1250 Gold and requires 5 games played as a Frontline champion.


 	Blindsider

 	Now rewards 1250 Gold and requires 5 games played as a Flank champion.


 	Never say Die

 	Now rewards 1250 Gold and requires 5 games played as a Support champion.


 	Adventure Awaits

 	Now rewards 1000 Essence and requires 10 games played.


 	Champion

 	Now rewards 1000 Essence and requires winning 6 games.


 	Together, Indomitable

 	Now rewards 1000 Essence and requires winning 4 games in a party.




 	Champion Price Changes

 	7,500 Gold Champs are now 12,500 Gold
 	5,000 Gold Champs are now 7,500 Gold
 	4,000 Gold Champs are now 5,000 Gold


 	Common/Uncommon Cosmetic Price Changes

 	Common Champion Skin Price

 	Gold Price Increased from 9500 to 14250
 	Crystal Price Decreased from 75 to 50


 	Common Weapon Price

 	Gold Price Increased from 4,750 to 7,125
 	Crystal Price Decreased from 50 to 25


 	Common Voice Pack Price

 	Gold Price Increased from 4,750 to 7,125
 	Crystal Price Decreased from 50 to 25


 	Uncommon Champion Skin Price

 	Gold Price Increased from 15,000 to 22,500
 	Crystal Price Decreased from 100 to 75


 	Uncommon Weapon Price

 	Gold Price Increased from 9,500 to 14,250
 	Crystal Price Decreased from 75 to 50






CHESTS

 	Winter is coming… in July!
Festive Chest is back for a limited time with additional new Character and Weapon Skins!

 	Tyra

 	Dire Wolf (Epic)

 	Champion skin + Voice Pack
 	Weapon




 	Inara

 	Ice Walker (Epic)

 	Champion skin + Voice Pack
 	Weapon




 	+ All past Festive content

 	NOTE: Evie Merrymaker Champion Set will include: Accessory, Body, and Voice Pack.





https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Landing-Large-HolidayChest.jpg 

MAPS

 	Test Queue rotation

 	Tilted (Onslaught)


 	Bug fixes:

 	Fixed an issue on Frozen Guard where players could see clip and see through certain collisions.




CHAMPIONS

“This patch, we have focused efforts around our Legendary Cards. We have a healthy variety of choices, but we believe some legendary cards are too strong when compared to the other available options. Additionally, many players have expressed that our hyper-movement based Legendaries are frustrating and not fun to play against. We highly value the experience of our players playing our characters AND playing against our characters. We believe strong and rewarding legendary options are important, and that we can introduce these cards without creating the frustration associated with the hypermobility Legendaries.

We are also taking this opportunity to make changes and improvement to some of our least used Legendary cards. Some will receive buffs, others will be entirely reworked. The legendary system is at it best when all 3 choices are genuine options, and some characters are in a good place! These changes are an attempt to move more characters in that direction, and we’ll be keeping a close eye on legendary usage throughout future patches.”

“After the range increase in OB53 Ash’s weapon was feeling less like a Flakk cannon. Now your Flak Projectiles will burst in the air when close to enemies, bringing the weapon more in line with its intended direction feel.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Evie.jpg

notes.notes:
https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/OB54-Launcher-Large-PatchNotes.jpg
Ice and Gunfire
Open Beta 54 Patch Notes | July 12th
Beta Expectations

New Champion: Lian, Scion of House Aico

 	Role: Damage
 	Health: 2000
 	Abilities

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Lian_Rifle80.png[LMB] Heirloom Rifle

A rifle that has been passed down through your noble house through the ages. Deals 400 damage every 0.45s at medium range.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Lian_Valor80.png[RMB] Valor

Fire a charged shot dealing 400 damage to all enemies in front of you. Acts as a weapon attack.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Lian_Presence80.png[Q] Presence

Charge your rifle for 0.5s then fire a long range shot that pierces enemies and deals 800 damage. Acts as a weapon attack.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Lian_Grace80.png[F] Grace

Quickly dodge in the direction you are moving and fire a rifle a shot dealing 400 damage to the enemy nearest to where you are aiming. Acts as a weapon attack.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Lian_Grace8080.png[E] Enlightenment

Channel the power of your noble blood to gain damage and CC immunity for 1s then fire a powerful blast that passes through enemies and deals 1600 damage. Killing an enemy with Enlightenment will refund 50% of your ultimate charge.
 

 	Legendaries

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Talent_Lian_Eminence.pngEminence [Default]

[Presence] Presence deals up to 50% more damage past 100 feet., and its Cooldown is reduced by 4s.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Talent_Lian_Alacrity-1.pngAlacrity

[Grace] Grace now hits all enemies in front you instead of only one, and its Cooldown is reduced by 1s.

https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Talent_Lian_Precision.pngPrecision

[Rifle] Deal 10% more damage with your rifle, and Grace generates 8 ammo.
 

 	Cards

 	Noble Crest

 	Inheritance

 	Signet Ring

 	Royal Seal

 	[Presence] Presence reduces healing by 50% for 1/2/3/4s.


 	Heraldry

 	[Presence] Hitting an enemy with Presence reduces its cooldown by 1.5/3/4.5/6s.


 	Present Arms

 	[Presence] Heal for 75/150/225/300 health after using Presence.


 	Heir to the Throne

 	[Grace] Move 10/20/30/40% faster during Grace.


 	Bloodline

 	[Grace] Heal for 50/100/150/200 Health after using Grace.


 	Divine Right

 	[Grace] Gain 10/20/30/40% movement Speed for 2s after using Grace.


 	Manifest Destiny

 	[Grace] Increase the dash distance of Grace by 8/16/24/32%.






GENERAL

 	Match Lobby improvements

 	Added ability to purchase and equip Collections
 	Added preview of map selection


 	Added new Acquisition notifications to Activity Center like Realm Pack and awarded Chests.
 	Added Filter by Champion in the Store.
 	Added new setting Toggle Zoom in Options > Gameplay for Iron Sights (Viktor) & Scope (Kinessa) to be toggled instead of held.

GENERAL BUG FIXES
Fixed Draft Mode match lobby where other players selecting Champions would close your Champion view after locking in.
Fixed 7-Day Booster acquisition showing incorrect count.
Fixed Mastery skins not equipping after unlocking from the Champion Overview.
Fixed Champions initially appearing locked after purchasing (Visual only).



GAME MODES
General

 	Players will now be able to earn match rewards from Training matches past account level 13

Onslaught

 	Teams will now gain additional respawn time based on how far ahead in tickets they are


CUSTOMIZATIONS

ECONOMY AND PROGRESSION

“At present, cards are too difficult to unlock. It’s always been our goal to offer meaningful character progression as you play Paladins, but as we have been listening to feedback and monitoring our data, it is clear that the time necessary to acquire cards is too long.

This Patch we will be addressing this issue from a few different angles. Players will be earning chests at an accelerated rate along with lower crafting costs (without a reduction in duplicate values), New avenues to earn essence, and a 60% increase in weekly quest gold rewards. Having a healthy economy is a balancing act and gold costs of cosmetic items and Champions will be increasing.”

 	Radiant Chest Cosmetic Drop Rates

 	Increased the Drop Rates of Cosmetics in Radiant Chests by 33%


 	The experience required per player level between levels 1 and 50 has been Reduced.

 	Previously experience requirements would cap out 1 million experience per level at level 30, now that cap is met at level 50.
 	As a result, almost all players will see their level increase and levels between 1 and 50 will require on average 35% less experience.


 	Card Crafting

 	Essence Cost Reduction

 	Epics: 5,000 to 4,000
 	Uncommon: 1,250 to 1,000
 	Common: 500 to 350

 	Common/Uncommon Cosmetic Price Changes

 	Common Weapon Price

CHESTS

“This patch, we have focused efforts around our Legendary Cards. We have a healthy variety of choices, but we believe some legendary cards are too strong when compared to the other available options. Additionally, many players have expressed that our hyper-movement based Legendaries are frustrating and not fun to play against. We highly value the experience of our players playing our characters AND playing against our characters. We believe strong and rewarding legendary options are important, and that we can introduce these cards without creating the frustration associated with the hypermobility Legendaries.

We are also taking this opportunity to make changes and improvement to some of our least used Legendary cards. Some will receive buffs, others will be entirely reworked. The legendary system is at it best when all 3 choices are genuine options, and some characters are in a good place! These changes are an attempt to move more characters in that direction, and we’ll be keeping a close eye on legendary usage throughout future patches.”
